examples.pinyin: Zhège jùzi tīng qǐlai hěn guài
examples.note: This sentence sounds very strange. 这个: 个 is usually neutral in speech. Its citation tone is gè. 句子: 子 is neutral. The u in 句 is ü: say “ee”, then round the lips. After j, q, x, and y the two dots are not written. 听起来 means “sounds”, the impression when you hear something. Do not read 起来 here as the verb “get up”. 来 in this pattern is usually neutral. Citation tone of 来 is lái. 怪 means strange. No 是 before 怪.

words.en: this (个 is usually neutral; citation tone gè)
sounds; seems when heard (来 is usually neutral; not the verb “get up”)

examples.pinyin: Zhège jùzi tīng qǐlai hěn guài
examples.note: This sentence sounds very strange. 这个: 个 is usually neutral in speech. Its citation tone is gè. 句子: 子 is neutral. The u in 句 is ü: say “ee”, then round the lips.
